mapper.select: SELECT M.CO_CD, M.REQ_NO, M.REQ_DT, M.REQ_TITL, M.REQ_ID, /* 개인 정보(TB_CM06M01) 사원 마스터의 실제 부서코드를 최우선으로 적용 */ NVL((SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM TB_CM06M01 U WHERE U.ID = M.REQ_ID), M.REQ_DEPT_ID) AS REQ_DEPT_ID, M.VAC_TYPE_CD, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = M.VAC_TYPE_CD) AS VAC_TYPE_NM, (SELECT CODE_ETC FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = M.VAC_TYPE_CD) AS CODE_ETC, FN_CM06M01_ID_TO_NM(M.REQ_ID) AS REQ_ID_NM, (SELECT DEPT_NM FROM TB_CM04M01 WHERE DEPT_ID = NVL((SELECT U.DEPT_ID FROM TB_CM06M01 U WHERE U.ID = M.REQ_ID), M.REQ_DEPT_ID)) AS REQ_DEPT_NM, M.AMPM_CD, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = M.AMPM_CD) AS AMPM_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.ST_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ST_DT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.ED_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ED_DT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.ST_TM, 'HH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS ST_TM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M.ED_TM, 'HH24MI'), 'HH24:MI') AS ED_TM, M.ST_TM AS RAW_ST_TM, M.ED_TM AS RAW_ED_TM, M.VAC_DAYS, M.DEDUCT_DAYS, M.REQ_RMK, /* 상세 조회 시에도 실시간 결재선(TB_WB20M03) 기준 결재상태 정밀 산출 */ NVL(( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN W.TODO_CF_DT IS NOT NULL AND (W.SANCTN_STTUS = 'N' OR W.SANCTN_STTUS = 'R' OR W.SANCTN_STTUS = '4') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'RTN' WHEN COUNT(W.TODO_KEY) = 0 THEN 'TEMP' WHEN COUNT(W.TODO_KEY) > 0 AND COUNT(W.TODO_KEY) = SUM(CASE WHEN W.TODO_CF_DT IS NOT NULL AND W.SANCTN_STTUS != 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'END' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN W.SANCTN_SN > 1 AND W.TODO_CF_DT IS NOT NULL AND W.SANCTN_STTUS != 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'ING' ELSE 'REQ' END FROM TB_WB20M03 W WHERE W.TODO_NO = M.REQ_NO AND W.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20' ), NVL(M.SANCTN_STS, 'TEMP')) AS SANCTN_STS, M.WORK_RPT_YN, M.FILE_TRGT_KEY, M.CREAT_ID, TO_CHAR(M.CREAT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_PM07M01 M WHERE M.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM07M01 ( CO_CD, REQ_NO, REQ_DT, REQ_TITL, REQ_ID, REQ_DEPT_ID, VAC_TYPE_CD, AMPM_CD, ST_DT, ED_DT, ST_TM, ED_TM, VAC_DAYS, DEDUCT_DAYS, REQ_RMK, SANCTN_STS, WORK_RPT_YN, FILE_TRGT_KEY, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqDeptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vacTypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ampmCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{edTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vacDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{deductDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reqRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sanctnSts, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', #{fileTrgtKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM07M01 SET REQ_TITL = #{reqTitl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VAC_TYPE_CD = #{vacTypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AMPM_CD = #{ampmCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ST_DT = #{stDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ED_DT = #{edDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ST_TM = #{stTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ED_TM = #{edTm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VAC_DAYS = #{vacDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DEDUCT_DAYS = #{deductDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REQ_RMK = #{reqRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM0701P01', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT GRANT_DAYS - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_ID = #{userId} AND YY = #{yy} AND SANCTN_STS = 'END'), 0) AS BALANCE FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT GRANT_DAYS AS grantDays, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(TO_DATE(REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = TO_NUMBER(#{yy}) AND SANCTN_STS = 'END'), 0) AS usedDays, GRANT_DAYS - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(DEDUCT_DAYS) FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(TO_DATE(REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = TO_NUMBER(#{yy}) AND SANCTN_STS = 'END'), 0) AS balanceDays FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM07M02 ( CO_CD, YY, USER_ID, GRANT_DAYS, AUTO_YN, RMK, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{yy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{grantDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{autoYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), #{rmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P02', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM07M02 SET GRANT_DAYS = #{grantDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, AUTO_YN = NVL(#{autoYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), RMK = #{rmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM0701P02', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND YY = #{yy, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT CO_CD, YY, USER_ID, GRANT_DAYS, AUTO_YN, RMK, CREAT_ID, CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PM07M02 WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND YY = #{yy} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT U.ID AS USER_ID, U.NAME AS USER_NM, D.DEPT_NM, TO_CHAR(U.ENTER_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ENTER_DT, TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LEAVE_DT FROM TB_CM06M01 U LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON D.DEPT_ID = SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y' /* 임원실(GUN00), 실적관리용(GUN95) 부서는 제외 */ AND SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) NOT IN ('GUN00', 'GUN95') AND (U.LEAVE_DT IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(U.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYY') >= #{yy}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PM07M02 M WHERE M.YY = #{yy} AND M.USER_ID = U.ID ) ORDER BY NVL(D.SORT_NO, 9999) ASC, D.DEPT_NM ASC, U.NAME ASC
SELECT 'VAC' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(TB_PM07M01_SQ01.NEXTVAL, 10000), 4, '0') FROM DUAL

SELECT S.CODE_ID AS WORK_RPT_S, S.CODE_KIND AS WORK_RPT_M, M.CODE_KIND AS WORK_RPT_L FROM TB_CM05M01 S JOIN TB_CM05M01 M ON M.CODE_ID = S.CODE_KIND WHERE S.CODE_ID LIKE '%9901' AND ( S.CODE_ID LIKE SUBSTR(#{deptId}, 1, 5) || '%' OR S.CODE_ID LIKE #{deptId} || '%' OR 1=1 ) AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY (CASE WHEN S.CODE_ID LIKE SUBSTR(#{deptId}, 1, 5) || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT TB_PM01M01_SQ01.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM01M01 ( FILE_TRGT_KEY, CO_CD, WORK_RPT_NO, WORK_RPT_ID, WORK_RPT_DT, WORK_RPT_L, WORK_RPT_M, WORK_RPT_S, WORK_RPT_HOUR, WORK_RPT_RMK, ISSUE_YN, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{fileTrgtKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptL, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptM, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptS, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workRptRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{issueYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT ENTER_DT FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE ID = #{userId}
SELECT 'DM' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')||'-'||LPAD(MOD(TB_PM01M01_SQ02.NEXTVAL, 10000), 4, '0') FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PM07M03 (CO_CD, REQ_NO, VAC_DT, WORK_HOUR, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM) VALUES ( #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vacDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM0701P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.delete: /* 휴가/근태 삭제/수정 시 TB_PM01M01 에 자동 등록된 일일작업일지 레코드 제거 */ DELETE FROM TB_PM01M01 WHERE WORK_RPT_ID = (SELECT REQ_ID FROM TB_PM07M01 WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo}) AND WORK_RPT_DT IN (SELECT VAC_DT FROM TB_PM07M03 WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo}) AND (WORK_RPT_S LIKE '%9901' OR WORK_RPT_S LIKE '%9903')
mapper.select: SELECT CO_CD, REQ_NO, VAC_DT, WORK_HOUR, WORK_RPT_NO FROM TB_PM07M03 WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo} ORDER BY VAC_DT ASC

SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NM, A.DEPT_ID, A.DEPT_NM, A.SORT_NO, A.ENTER_DT, A.BASE_DT, A.WORK_YEARS, A.GRANT_DAYS, A.PREV_DAYS, A.M01, A.M02, A.M03, A.M04, A.M05, A.M06, A.M07, A.M08, A.M09, A.M10, A.M11, A.M12, A.M01_DETAIL, A.M02_DETAIL, A.M03_DETAIL, A.M04_DETAIL, A.M05_DETAIL, A.M06_DETAIL, A.M07_DETAIL, A.M08_DETAIL, A.M09_DETAIL, A.M10_DETAIL, A.M11_DETAIL, A.M12_DETAIL, (A.M01 + A.M02 + A.M03 + A.M04 + A.M05 + A.M06 + A.M07 + A.M08 + A.M09 + A.M10 + A.M11 + A.M12) AS USED_DAYS_SUM, (A.GRANT_DAYS + A.PREV_DAYS - (A.M01 + A.M02 + A.M03 + A.M04 + A.M05 + A.M06 + A.M07 + A.M08 + A.M09 + A.M10 + A.M11 + A.M12)) AS BALANCE_DAYS, A.LEAVE_DT, A.USE_YN, A.SALES_AREA, A.JOB_DIV_NM, CASE WHEN A.USE_YN = 'N' AND A.LEAVE_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(A.LEAVE_DT) = 8 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.LEAVE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'FMMM/FMDD') || ' 퇴사' ELSE A.RMK END AS RMK FROM ( SELECT U.ID AS USER_ID, U.NAME AS USER_NM, SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) AS DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM, NVL(D.SORT_NO, 999) AS SORT_NO, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(U.ENTER_DT, '[^0-9]', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ENTER_DT, #{yy} || '-12-31' AS BASE_DT, CASE WHEN U.ENTER_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(U.ENTER_DT, '[^0-9]', '')) = 8 THEN TO_CHAR(TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(#{yy} || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(U.ENTER_DT, '[^0-9]', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) / 12), 'FM00') || '년 ' || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(#{yy} || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(U.ENTER_DT, '[^0-9]', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')), 12)), 'FM00') || '개월' ELSE '' END AS WORK_YEARS, NVL(G.GRANT_DAYS, 0) AS GRANT_DAYS, 0.0 AS PREV_DAYS, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '01' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M01, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '02' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M02, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '03' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M03, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '04' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M04, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '05' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M05, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '06' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M06, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '07' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M07, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '08' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M08, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '09' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M09, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '10' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M10, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '11' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M11, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '12' THEN V.DEDUCT_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS M12, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '01' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M01_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '02' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M02_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '03' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M03_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '04' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M04_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '05' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M05_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '06' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M06_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '07' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M07_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '08' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M08_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '09' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M09_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '10' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M10_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '11' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M11_DETAIL, LISTAGG(CASE WHEN V.VAC_MONTH = '12' THEN V.DETAIL_INFO END, CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.VAC_DT) AS M12_DETAIL, REGEXP_REPLACE(U.LEAVE_DT, '[^0-9]', '') AS LEAVE_DT, U.USE_YN, U.SALES_AREA, CASE WHEN U.SALES_AREA = 'SALESAREA60' THEN '생산직' WHEN U.SALES_AREA = 'SALESAREA00' THEN '임원' ELSE '사무직' END AS JOB_DIV_NM, NVL(G.RMK, '') AS RMK FROM TB_CM06M01 U LEFT JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON D.DEPT_ID = SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) LEFT JOIN TB_PM07M02 G ON G.YY = #{yy} AND G.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT M.REQ_ID, D.VAC_DT, SUBSTR(D.VAC_DT, 5, 2) AS VAC_MONTH, CASE WHEN C.CODE_NM LIKE '%반차%' OR C.CODE_NM LIKE '%오전%' OR C.CODE_NM LIKE '%오후%' THEN 0.5 ELSE (CASE WHEN NVL(D.WORK_HOUR, '8') = '4' THEN 0.5 ELSE 1 END) END AS DEDUCT_DAYS, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(D.VAC_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || NVL(C.CODE_NM, '연차') || '(' || (CASE WHEN C.CODE_NM LIKE '%반차%' OR C.CODE_NM LIKE '%오전%' OR C.CODE_NM LIKE '%오후%' OR NVL(D.WORK_HOUR, '8') = '4' THEN '0.5' ELSE '1' END) || '일)' || CASE WHEN M.REQ_RMK IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(M.REQ_RMK)) > 0 THEN ' [' || TRIM(M.REQ_RMK) || ']' ELSE '' END AS DETAIL_INFO FROM TB_PM07M01 M JOIN TB_PM07M03 D ON M.REQ_NO = D.REQ_NO LEFT JOIN TB_CM05M01 C ON M.VAC_TYPE_CD = C.CODE_ID WHERE SUBSTR(D.VAC_DT, 1, 4) = #{yy} AND NVL(M.SANCTN_STS, 'TEMP') != 'RTN' AND (C.CODE_NM LIKE '%연차%' OR C.CODE_NM LIKE '%년차%' OR C.CODE_NM LIKE '%반차%' OR C.CODE_NM LIKE '%오전%' OR C.CODE_NM LIKE '%오후%') ) V ON U.ID = V.REQ_ID WHERE 1=1 AND (NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID) IS NULL OR NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID) NOT LIKE 'GUN95%') AND (U.SALES_AREA IS NULL OR U.SALES_AREA != 'SALESAREA00')
AND U.USE_YN = #{useYn_S}
AND SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5) = SUBSTR(#{deptCd_S}, 1, 5)
AND D.DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{deptNm_S} || '%'
AND (U.NAME LIKE '%' || #{userNm_S} || '%' OR U.ID LIKE '%' || #{userNm_S} || '%')
AND U.ID = #{userId_S}
AND U.SALES_AREA = 'SALESAREA60'
AND (U.SALES_AREA IS NULL OR U.SALES_AREA != 'SALESAREA60')
GROUP BY U.ID, U.NAME, SUBSTR(NVL(U.VIEW_DEPT_ID, U.DEPT_ID), 1, 5), D.DEPT_NM, D.SORT_NO, U.ENTER_DT, U.LEAVE_DT, U.USE_YN, U.SALES_AREA, G.GRANT_DAYS, G.RMK ) A ORDER BY A.SORT_NO ASC, A.DEPT_NM ASC, A.USER_NM ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM07M01 SET MNG_RMK = #{mngRmk, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM0701M01', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE CO_CD = #{coCd} AND REQ_NO = #{reqNo}
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_KEY, FILE_SIZE, FILE_TYPE, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_TRGT_TYP, FILE_TRGT_KEY, CO_CD, COMON_CD, CREAT_ID, TO_CHAR(CREAT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_CM08M01 WHERE FILE_TRGT_TYP = 'PM0701P01' AND FILE_TRGT_KEY = #{fileTrgtKey} ORDER BY FILE_KEY ASC
